title: A Day at the Bookshop
setting: A small, bright bookshop with a little cafe corner, on a cold winter day.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

sentences.en: In February, Mia and Ben visit a bookshop.
sentences.zh: 二月里，米娅和本去逛一家书店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans), in a winter coat, and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), in a winter coat and a yellow woolly hat, walk into a small bright bookshop, snowy street behind them.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a winter visit to a bookshop; the month can't be shown.

sentences.en: Mia buys a blue book about birds there.
sentences.zh: 米娅在那里买了一本讲鸟的蓝色书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) holds up a blue book with a bird on the cover at the bookshop counter.

sentences.en: Then they eat egg sandwiches and hot chips.
sentences.zh: 然后他们吃鸡蛋三明治和热薯条。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), with a yellow woolly hat, sit at a little table in the bookshop cafe with egg sandwiches and a bowl of hot chips.

sentences.en: Ben drops his plate, and it breaks.
sentences.zh: 本把盘子掉在地上，盘子摔碎了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks shocked as his plate falls and breaks into pieces on the cafe floor.

sentences.en: He feels bad, and his face goes red.
sentences.zh: 他觉得很过意不去，脸都红了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) stands with a red, embarrassed face next to the broken plate.

sentences.en: Mia finds Ben's hat below the table.
sentences.zh: 米娅在桌子下面找到了本的帽子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) bends down and picks up a yellow woolly hat from under the cafe table.

sentences.en: "Do not lose your hat," she tells him.
sentences.zh: “别把你的帽子弄丢了。”她对他说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) hands the yellow woolly hat back to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), wagging a finger kindly.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia giving Ben his hat with a warning finger; the spoken words can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Tonight, they will read the new book together.
sentences.zh: 今晚，他们要一起读这本新书。
sentences.scene_prompt: At night, Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sit on a sofa under a lamp reading the blue book with a bird on the cover.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them reading the book together at night; the future 'will' can't be shown.
